description_expanded: This hospitable vacation home has an Old Florida Architectural design that abounds with the kind of warmth and charm like you might find in Key West, yet it features amenities that provide all the creature comforts you may desire. Accommodating amenities include the sensational sparkling paradise that is just one block away, thousands of square feet of interconnected swimming pools! These awesome pools connect on different levels with cascading waterfalls that flow down from one into another. The highest raised pool features a large circular fountain where children may enjoy refreshing frolic along with their parents since a spray mists down from its center. A shallow entry pool is available for kids while two long designated lap pools are set aside for avid adult swimmers. This enchanting setting is bordered by tropical gardens adorned with towering palm trees and picnic pavilions for al fresco family meals with friends. Lush lawns and gardens include an adjacent outdoor amphitheater that stages occasional seasonal concerts. Anytime you are tempted to leave this heavenly oasis a convenient Community Beach Tram can whisk you down to the beautiful beach, which is just minutes away. You may also bike there since this home comes with eight bicycles for a leisurely ride down to the sugary shore. As soon as you spy Hemingway at 30A you are immediately embraced by its lovely laid-back ambiance. A railed front porch beside some palm trees includes rocking chairs, inviting you to "sit for a spell." A long wrap around columned covered balcony up above provides another spot to sip some lemonade or perhaps a margarita while enjoying the gulf breezes. The bright sunny open living area is accentuated by high ceilings, lots of windows and light blonde toned hardwood floors. A grey couch, two creamy cushioned accent chairs, and a reclaimed wood coffee table provides a comfortable seating ensemble facing a flatscreen TV. The cozy couch conveniently doubles as a queen-sized sleeper sofa for added bedding. A dark handsome hardwood dining table beside a wall of bay windows includes eight classic colonial styled chairs with thatched woven straw seats. The contemporary kitchen nearby features stainless steel appliances, rich custom cabinetry and two vintage modern mid-century stools next to a light malt colored granite topped island. The spacious Primary Bedroom includes a king-sized bed, a private en-suite luxury bath with dual vanity sinks and doors that lead out to the wonderful porch balcony. The other bedrooms include queen-sized beds and are individually decorated with distinct cottage charm. One of them is located in a Carriage House with an en-suite bath providing a perfect place for an individual couple. The carriage house also features a living room with a queen-sized sleeper sofa and a full-size kitchen. Up to 12 happy guests may stay at this gracious four bedroom vacation home. This sought after Seacrest Beach location in South Walton has a breakfast place, a sandwich shop, a pizzeria and Mexican restaurant very close by. It is also a very short distance away from Rosemary Beach , which is an enchanting West Indies inspired Dutch Colonial village that offers a wide array of fine restaurants,  bistros, galleries, specialty shops, clothing boutiques, free outdoor concerts and fun festivals for every season Main House: First Floor: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Patio Access, Dining, Kitchen, Queen Bedroom with Shared Tub/Shower Combo. Second Floor: King Primary Suite with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo and Balcony Access, Laundry. Guest House:  First Floor: Garage (Non-Accessible), Exterior Stairs. Second Floor: Living Room Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchen, Queen Bedroom with Shared Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, Laundry. Beach tram available seasonally (March-October)
